content:
Thank you for your screen shot which looks like the third one of my collection. As a doctor would say "your picture is pathognomonic for a corrupt prefs.js file"... PC or Thunderbird crashes or power outage can damage prefs.js which is one of the most important files in the Thunderbird profile since it contains, among other data, all account parameters. When this happens Thunderbird renames the prefs.js file in prefs-.js (or invalidprefs,js) and creates a new virgin prefs,js file with a size of 6 to 7 kB which doesn't contain any account parameters.

In the Thunderbird menu bar go to Help > Troubleshooting Information > Profile Folder > Open Folder, then quit Thunderbird. The contents of the profile folder is now displayed in an Explorer window: to confirm the diagnostic search for a prefs.js file with a size of 6 or 7 kB and a prefs-1 (or prefs-x.js) file with an actual time stamp and a size of several dozen kB. If you have a backup copy of your Thunderbird profile folder make a copy of the prefs.js file and replace the actual virgin prefs.js with the copy. Then restart Thunderbird.

BACKUP

  1. ensure thunderbird is not running

That error message can be caused by a number of things, and they're not necessarily obvious from its wording. Two of the most common cause are:

- Anti-virus programs are notorious for interfering with email operation. Try temporarily disabling it or creating an exception for your Thunderbird Profile folder. If you use Windows, restarting it in Safe Mode With Networking will test it.

- There could be a corrupt message on the server that either that server or Thunderbird doesn't like. If you go to your email provider's webmail, you may be able to identify it by date and delete it from there, after which normal operation will (hopefully) resume.

WHy are you trying to edit the layout of the message you are quoting is perhaps the correct question to ask.

Ebay, like most multinational conglomerates that make their money online spend a lot of money on software developers and webpage authors, under the hood, an email is a web page. What you are seeing is the result of (I must guess here because I have no access to the actual message source code.) complex cascading style sheets embedded in the message by Ebay what they created it. You will not find some button to "fix" the deliberate decisions of Ebay in their document formatting.

While I am not privy too their corporate style guide, I have observed that they, like the replies you get by email from this forum, only use the center part of the screen for text. This is partially to allow for good formatting on long narrow screens (think phones) but it also makes reading of text easier if it is limited in line length. Generally a line length of 56 - 75 character is considered the optimum. So you see those with lots of professional assistance in their compositing setting line standards in that range. For the rest of us we use the automatic line wrap that comes with the edge of the screen. Be that a 100 inch television of a tiny phone screen.

So you can go out a lean CSS and how to embed it into your HTML emails, or just accept that that is how it is. Or use a table to emulate the effect Ebay use which will look something like this

That set up using insert table thus

But it is a lot of effort for little gain for a quick reply. I would be inclined to simple skip the HTML entirely. Hold the shift key on your reply so the message gets converted to plain text in the quote and then what you write will align with the quote.. It will however not look much like the quoted message. The image below is the same message in the other images but quoted as plain text.

I do suggest you simply use templates for your Ebay replies and do not quote the original message at all (it is a setting you have full control over) Just quote the item number in your reply just incase the peson has multiple ebay sellers they are corresponding with.

I would also suggest you use this addon. https://addons.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/addon/smarttemplate4/?src=ss it simplifies the template process for those running a small business and makes repeatable quick responses a reality.
